faq_desc: The most frequently asked questions about Erasmus+, the application process and using the platform.
faq_a1: Nomad Youth is a digital platform created so young people can find opportunities such as Erasmus+, volunteering, internships, grants, training and other development programs in one place. Here you can explore opportunities matching your interests and go straight to the official application links.
faq_q2: Does Nomad Youth organize the projects itself?
faq_a2: No. Nomad Youth does not organize projects directly. We gather opportunities shared by various organizations on one platform and direct you to the official application page.
faq_a3: Erasmus+ is the European Union's international program supporting education, youth, training and sports. Under this program, young people can take part in trainings, youth exchanges, volunteering programs and other development opportunities in different countries.
faq_q4: What's the difference between Erasmus+ and a Youth Exchange?
faq_a4: Erasmus+ is the name of the overall program. A Youth Exchange is one of the short-term youth mobility formats organized under Erasmus+, where young people from different countries come together around a topic to learn and share experience.
faq_a5: ESC stands for European Solidarity Corps. This program is mainly intended for volunteering activities, where participants can take part in social, cultural or environmental projects in different countries.
faq_a6: No. Young people from Azerbaijan can apply to Erasmus+ and other international opportunities. Each project simply has different participating countries, age ranges and application conditions. It's important to carefully check the terms of each announcement.
faq_q7: Who can apply to Erasmus+ projects?
faq_a7: This varies from project to project. Many Youth Exchange projects are for the 18–30 age range, but there are also opportunities open to participants aged 13–17, 30+ and even 35+. The age and participation conditions of each project should be checked separately.
faq_q8: Is participation in Erasmus+ projects paid?
faq_a8: Most Erasmus+ projects cover training, accommodation and food costs. Some projects may require a small participation fee or upfront travel costs. We recommend checking the financial terms before applying.
faq_q9: Are travel, accommodation and food costs covered?
faq_a9: Many Erasmus+ projects cover accommodation, food and activity costs. Travel costs may be reimbursed afterwards within a certain limit, or partially covered. Exact details are stated in the project announcement.
faq_q10: How can I apply to an Erasmus+ project?
faq_a10: Choose the project that suits you, read the terms carefully and click the "Apply" button. This will take you to the project's official application page or the form indicated by the organizer.
faq_q11: Do I need to know English perfectly?
faq_a11: No. For most projects, a basic level of English good enough for communication is sufficient. What matters most is active participation and openness to learning. Some professional programs may require a higher language level.
faq_q12: Why are a CV and motivation letter needed?
faq_a12: A CV gives brief information about your education, experience and skills. A motivation letter explains why you want to join that specific project. Not every project requires these documents, but when they do, they matter for your application.
faq_q13: Can I apply to several projects at the same time?
faq_a13: Yes. You can apply to several projects at the same time. It's just better to tailor each application to its specific project for a better result.
faq_q14: Is Nomad Youth responsible for my application or acceptance result?
faq_a14: No. Nomad Youth presents opportunities on one platform and directs you to the official application page. Evaluating the application and the acceptance result is the direct responsibility of the organization running the project.
faq_q15: How can I share my project on Nomad Youth?
faq_a15: If you are an organization or initiative creating opportunities for young people, you can contact us to share your project on the Nomad Youth platform. We'll be glad to respond and discuss how it can reach more young people and explore collaboration opportunities.
faq_q16: How can I become a partner with Nomad Youth?
faq_a16: Nomad Youth is open to collaboration with organizations, initiatives and companies that create opportunities for young people. You can contact us to discuss reaching a wider audience with your projects, joint activities and mutual visibility opportunities.
